title: Let the Shabad lead doubt into Sangat
summary: The Guru's Word fills the heart with reverence and keeps it joined to the True Congregation. Doubt begins to clear when remembrance stops being private noise and becomes shared praise.
takeaway: Let the Guru's Word move you from private doubt into true company.
lifeApplication: If certainty has become a private argument, take one line into Sangat or trusted prayerful company today. Let shared praise answer what analysis keeps reopening.

source.shortMeaning: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad awakens reverence and keeps the seeker joined to Sat Sangat, dwelling on the True One's glories.
source.lifeApplication: Bring the question into remembrance with others instead of letting it echo alone.
